text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian is registered for the Takarazuka Kinen, where her sister, Biwa Hayahide, will also be racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the two of them have a once-in-a-lifetime chance to face each other at their very best. The curtains rise on their sisterly showdown!
